request.prompt: Extreme close-up looking down at an antique leather ledger with yellowed pages on a wooden desk, faded handwritten brown ink on the page reads "Elena Marlowe — died 1 November". The index finger of a woman in her late twenties with long dark wavy hair, wearing a fitted black button-up blouse with a collar rests on the ink; only her hand and black blouse cuff are visible. A single candle flame at the edge of frame. Use the woman in the reference image. candlelit, warm amber highlights, deep black shadows, slight film grain, cinematic dark romance film, vertical 9:16 frame.
